Server.//AllowInvalidCertificate: Debug-only. The API serves src/API/Certificates/certificate.pfx, a self-signed certificate whose private key is committed to this repository, so it cannot validate. Track 7 (NR-2026-004/005) made ServerCertificatePolicy default to validating, which is correct and must stay that way for real installations: docs/security/SECRETS.md requires this key to be unset on every deployed client. It is set here only because ClientConfigurationSources.Development is the Debug-only source list, so a Release build reads appsettings.json instead and never sees it. The supported alternative is trusting the certificate in the OS trust store - see docs/security/DATA_PROTECTION.md.
